notes.title: 6th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/13455aa236900e0fe8c156c754b8969e53518092.gif[/img]

Hello again, it is the anniversary for the game. It has now been six years since I've released Jump Off The Bridge. When I started this years ago, I didn't expect I'd still be working on this game even now. Perhaps I am much more stubborn than I ever gave myself credit to be - to some a curse, others a boon I suppose. I'm almost 30 years old now, which feels weird to say, since I don't feel 30. I'm enjoying myself when I can, as I hope you are. This update is silly, because I decided to let a joke fall out of my head and put it in a level (Jester at the helm). I've been reshaping my ideology; with the last update, and this as well, I'm making more room for the things that I value and reconnecting with what made me want to make this in the first place. Standards are being defenestrated, along with perfectionism. Imperfection-maxxxing is the new skill I'm working towards. At the end of the day a step is still a step, backwards or forwards. I'd rather move than be immobilized by the sultry 'what if.' Where is this game going? Well I have a lot I still want to do, and I intend to continue working on it. There's a lot of rough edges, but I'm finding the courage to show them. Let's see what I can get done this year. This update adds a level, and fixes a bunch of bugs. I worked on the rebinding menus and controller settings stuff, so that should be more accurate and function better. I haven't made any progress on the Level Editor or Hardmode stuff just yet, maybe next time. Thank you for your support, and thank you for being interested in my weird game. We'll talk soon.

Sincerely,
Your friend,
Cody

notes.title: V1.2.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/8fe02a04ac5a450660ca69e2ec5c923b416ca363.png[/img]

After two and a half years of struggling to release something, I gave myself a new goal: "Whatever I get done by Christmas, I'll release it." Rather than the lofty expectations, or the insidious perfectionism, I aimed to simply just have fun, and to let my heart roam. I had to overcome some things first, some of which you'll face in the update. I expect this update will have many bugs, many loose ends and threads, some in different shades of finish or polish. Regardless it is important for me break the curse of this long sojourn I've had, and simply reconnect with the game and art that was fun for me. A gift for me, a gift for you. Here's to the walk, cheers. We'll talk soon. 

Thank you for being you.
Sincerely,
Cody Penn

notes.title: Preview of Version 2.6
notes.notes:
Hello!

It has been almost a year since Jump Off The Bridge has been updated, for everyone still here, thank you for your support. This past year I've learned a lot of important lessons, some difficult, some enjoyable, some sad, some happy. But in all I'm proud I was given the opportunity to learn them. If there's anything I want to impart with my game, it is that you don't fail until you give up - that every mistake is a learning opportunity, a potential stepping stone to something you never expected. I'm going to keep trudging along, I hope you will as well. Until then, good luck, and keep up the fight.

Sincerely, 
Cody Penn

Happy 4th Anniversary for Jump Off The Bridge!

notes.title: VERSION 2.3 POLAR BEAR LEVEL
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a couple of months! I ran into a bunch of bugs with the latest Betas of GMS2, so I decided to hold off until those had been patched before I exported a new executable. Since everything seems to be stable, I'm releasing an update with a new level: The Polar Bear Level (and an Achievement). 

This update also includes quite a bit of work on the Gamepad and Keyboard binding controls. The menus should work better overall, allow more intricate binding, and I've fixed the D-Pad movement. Now by default both the Joystick and the D-Pad work for movement, so you can use them interchangeably whilst playing. As well as there was an annoying bug that prevented rebinding on the Keyboard, so that's fixed now!

Also I've enabled Screenshots! Press F12 to Screenshot a part of the game!

Next up will be the Pottery Level voted by my Patreons, featured in the Previews, just have to finish up some work on it before I ship it. I'm aiming for sometime later this week!

[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Hello again everyone!

I'm changing my philosophy. I've spent too long working on this update, and entered a self-defeating cycle of "took more-time need more-content." My scope for V2.1 was far too grand, and so I'm cutting my losses, and am changing my philosophy. Every time I finish a level, I'm going to update the game. Sorry for the incredibly long wait, hopefully you enjoy what I have in store! All the levels that are a work-in-progress have been denoted accordingly.

[h1]Life News[/h1]
With the help of my family, my patrons, and your support, I'm now renting an office space. notes.title: Version 1.2 Update! Partial 官话 Support! Checkpoint System! 存档! 谢谢!
notes.notes:
[h1]V1.2 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mandarin Support for game text. (All menus will be converted later.)
[*] Archive/Save/Checkpoint System in place on key levels!
[*] Infinite Bridge Solution Transition improved.
[/list]

Hey everyone,

I've been getting a lot of messages about archiving/saving progress. With this patch, I have introduced a system that saves your progress. The first checkpoint is located at the "Puzzle Dog Level." When you've unlocked a checkpoint, it is denoted by the large green lock that appears on your screen. I may add text for that later. When you startup Easymode, you will be taken to a screen that allows you to select the checkpoint you'd like to start at.

I've also been asked about Mandarin support. I've added a menu on load that allows for you to select between English and Mandarin. All the NPC's in game text has been translated via Google Translate, I will be hiring a proper Translator at the end of the month to get better translations. I also will overhaul the menus in a future update to allow the entire game in Mandarin.

Next update will be a content update with more levels in several weeks. Until then, thank you for playing Jump Off The Bridge!  

-Cody Penn
